blocking_reasons: The repository has no authenticated intraday market-data provider.
No TWSE and TPEx cross-market minute-bar run has been verified in the GitHub Actions environment.
Corporate-action and abnormal-trading handling has not been verified end to end.
No append-only point-in-time intraday snapshot store exists yet.

source_assessment.historical_retention: No public minute-bar retention contract was found in the OpenAPI specification.
source_assessment.notes: TWSE offers real-time and historical transaction information as information products, but the current repository does not subscribe to those products.

source_assessment.historical_retention: No public minute-bar retention contract was verified for the current pipeline.
source_assessment.notes: TPEx real-time information requires a contract or an authorized information vendor.

source_assessment.historical_retention: Minute candles return the most recent 30 days and do not accept custom from/to ranges.
source_assessment.notes: Documentation covers TWSE and TPEx candles and separate corporate-action endpoints. The unauthenticated feasibility probe returned HTTP 401; no credential or paid-plan behavior was tested.

activation_criteria: Configure the provider credential only through GitHub Actions Secrets.
Verify TWSE and TPEx common-stock coverage for at least five trading days.
Verify 1, 5, 30 and 60 minute OHLCV aggregation against source timestamps.
Implement append-only raw snapshot storage before calculating signals.
Verify dividend, split, capital reduction, halt, disposition and delayed-opening handling.
Add replay tests proving that bars received after a trigger timestamp cannot change the historical decision.
limitations: This file defines a disabled interface only; it does not generate ORH signals.
The requested ORH fields are not added to daily artifacts while the reliability gate is false.
Daily OHLCV must never be used to reconstruct or guess an opening-range breakout.
